test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who does not believe in the existence of God
solution: The correct answer is: **Atheist** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **atheist **is a person who does not believe in the existence of God. (वह व्यक्ति जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं करता) • The word 'atheist' is a noun. • The prefix '**a**-' means 'not' or 'without', so 'atheist' literally means 'without God'. • The opposite of 'atheist' is 'theist', which means a person who believes in God. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Priest **is a religious leader who performs sacred rituals and offers spiritual guidance to people. (एक धार्मिक नेता जो पवित्र अनुष्ठान करता है और लोगों को आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करता है) • **Theist **is a person who believes in the existence of God or gods. (एक व्यक्ति जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास करता है) • **Satan** is a term used to refer to the devil or a personification of evil in some religions. (कुछ धर्मों में शैतान या बुराई का अवतार) 42:T7b0, The correct answer is: **The famous filmmaker directed the movie and the studio produced it.**
